project.name: Brightsmile Dental online booking
project.description: Patients book dental appointments online instead of phoning the front desk.
project.business_problem: Patients can only book by phoning the front desk during opening hours.
business_objectives: Let patients book appointments outside opening hours without phoning

requirements.title: Book an appointment online
requirements.description: A patient books an appointment by choosing a dentist, a treatment type and a free time slot from the calendar.
requirements.evidence: The patient picks a dentist, a treatment type and a free time slot from the calendar.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient on the booking page, when they select a dentist, treatment and free slot and confirm, then the appointment is saved and the slot is no longer shown as free.

requirements.title: Send booking confirmation email
requirements.description: After a booking is saved, the patient receives a confirmation email stating the appointment date, time and dentist.
requirements.evidence: After booking, the patient receives a confirmation email with the date, time and dentist.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient has confirmed a booking When the appointment is saved Then the patient receives an email showing the appointment date, time and dentist

requirements.title: Booking window of 24 hours to 60 days
requirements.description: An appointment can be booked only if its start time is at least 24 hours and at most 60 days after the moment of booking.
requirements.evidence: Appointments can only be booked between 24 hours and 60 days in advance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a slot less than 24 hours away, when the patient views the calendar, then the slot cannot be selected.

requirements.title: Booking page load time
requirements.description: The booking page loads fast on desktop and mobile. The target load time is not stated.

nfr_metric.metric: booking page load time on mobile
nfr_metric.measurement: UNKNOWN — to be agreed with the client (see Q-001)

requirements.evidence: The booking page should load fast, even on mobile.

requirements.title: ClinicDesk remains the master calendar
requirements.description: The existing practice-management system, ClinicDesk, stays the master calendar. The booking feature must not replace it.
requirements.evidence: We must keep using our existing practice-management system (ClinicDesk) as the master calendar.

requirements.title: Read availability from and write bookings to ClinicDesk
requirements.description: Online booking reads free slots from ClinicDesk and writes each confirmed appointment back to ClinicDesk.
requirements.rationale: CON-001 makes ClinicDesk the master calendar, so the free slots shown in FR-001 must come from ClinicDesk, and new bookings must land there or the calendars diverge.

questions.text: What load time should the booking page meet on mobile, and on what kind of connection should it be measured?
questions.suggested_default_option: Option: page interactive within 3 s on a mid-range phone over 4G (p75 of real visits)
options: Other target set by the client
